name: ui-design
description: /ui-design new and /ui-design redesign open mockups in the browser, built from the project's own colors, type, spacing and components; redesign asks for the go-ahead before it changes project code; /ui-design audit checks the theme, the components and their consistency; /ui-design apply builds the picked variant of a saved design in project code; /ui-design fix fixes numbered audit findings in project code
